<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Lack of unified oversight for suppliers and policyholders",
 "problem_statement": "Teams struggle to track supplier communications, tasks, and performance across regions, while also lacking visibility into reserves. This makes it hard to coordinate effectively and make informed decisions."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 2,
 "mentions_n": 3,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "sales": 3
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 1060000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 0,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Thistlecombe Mutual",
   "arr_gbp": 980000.0,

   "mentions": 1
  },
  {
   "name": "Duncastle Auto",
   "arr_gbp": 80000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-08-19",
   "mentions": 2
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "98e8c29dbf07d279",
  "quote": "We’re counting on it — especially for managing suppliers and policyholders across multiple regions.",
  "account": "Thistlecombe Mutual",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-28T16:59:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "ac71e446fb1f70b7",
  "quote": "We’re also struggling with supplier comms and task tracking — it’s all tied together.",
  "account": "Duncastle Auto",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-14T16:28:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "cd70d49f5cfbb045",
  "quote": "That’ll be useful — we need better oversight on reserves and supplier performance.",
  "account": "Duncastle Auto",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-14T16:28:00Z"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word from one insight cited in the same sentence.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Claims-handling teams struggle to track supplier communications, tasks, and performance across regions, while also lacking visibility into reserves. This makes it hard to coordinate effectively and make informed decisions.

## Who is affected
- Claims teams at Thistlecombe Mutual, who are counting on better management of suppliers and policyholders across multiple regions [i:98e8c29dbf07d279].
- Claims teams at Duncastle Auto, who are struggling with supplier communications and task tracking [i:ac71e446fb1f70b7] and need better oversight on reserves and supplier performance [i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].

## Evidence
- Two accounts have mentioned this problem [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7][i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].
- There have been three total mentions of this problem [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7][i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].
- All three mentions came from the sales route [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7][i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].
- The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from these accounts is £1,060,000.0 [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7][i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].
- Thistlecombe Mutual has an ARR of £980,000.0 and one mention [i:98e8c29dbf07d279].
- Duncastle Auto has an ARR of £80,000.0 and two mentions [i:ac71e446fb1f70b7][i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].
- Zero renewals have occurred in the last 90 days [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7][i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].
- A Thistlecombe Mutual contact stated, "We’re counting on it — especially for managing suppliers and policyholders across multiple regions" on 2026-10-28 [i:98e8c29dbf07d279].
- A Duncastle Auto contact stated, "We’re also struggling with supplier comms and task tracking — it’s all tied together" on 2026-10-14 [i:ac71e446fb1f70b7].
- The same Duncastle Auto contact also stated, "That’ll be useful — we need better oversight on reserves and supplier performance" on 2026-10-14 [i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].

## Why now
- The problem has been raised by two key accounts, Thistlecombe Mutual and Duncastle Auto, which together represent £1,060,000.0 in ARR [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7][i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].
- Both accounts have upcoming renewals, with Duncastle Auto's on 2027-08-19 and Thistlecombe Mutual's on 2027-09-01 [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7][i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].
- The most recent feedback was provided on 2026-10-28, indicating the problem is a current and active concern for a major customer [i:98e8c29dbf07d279].
- The feedback from Duncastle Auto explicitly links the need for better oversight on reserves with supplier performance, indicating the interconnected nature of the problem is a present operational hurdle [i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].
- All feedback has come through the sales route, suggesting it is a factor in commercial conversations and potentially in renewal discussions [i:98e8c29dbf07d279][i:ac71e446fb1f70b7][i:cd70d49f5cfbb045].",
  "citations": ["98e8c29dbf07d279", "ac71e446fb1f70b7", "cd70d49f5cfbb045"]
}
